description: Locked @gymform.3d 4-step reel rules, implemented by gymform/{bg,mask,equipment,xray,muscle,layout,tempo,tts,qc}.py. A day differs only by configs/dayNN.json (exercise, clips, equipment, X-Ray bones, target muscles, callouts, TTS lines, caption, per-step alignment).

background.style: minimal dark charcoal studio, no props (no racks, slats, equipment in bg)
background.grade_source: Day 4 master backdrop median RGB (t543u); plate is graded per channel on load

skin_lock_all_steps.source: Day 4 master (output/day4_romanian_deadlift_4step_master.mp4), t542u: 6 frames (3/4/13/14/18/19 s), body-only ROI (upper back + lower legs, bar/plates excluded), the pipeline's skin definition (L>46, no activation)
skin_lock_all_steps.qc_max_why: Day 4 p99.9 on clean frames = 131-148 (body-only ROI) and 145-157 (central ROI incl. arms/hands, L>46) -> 160

mannequin.camera_angle: 3/4 views (front-3/4 and back-3/4), same framing every step

skin_by_construction.segments: upper arm, forearm to 80% (before hand), torso above hip band, knee..ankle
skin_by_construction.post_composite_skin_tone_lock: every step, every frame: monotonic map p75->165, p90->191, max->226, RGB scaled by the same gain (3D shading ratios kept); excludes X-Ray window, shorts, metal, activation colour
skin_by_construction.shorts_native_only: shorts = the source's own native 3D fabric pixels (mask.native_shorts, pose-aware hem along each thigh axis); no 2D polygon/fill; QC (n) 2d_overpaint_ratio == 0
skin_by_construction.skin_shadow_floor: skin never renders darker than its own native shadow up to lum 62 (muscle.silver_skin)

mannequin.equal_size_metric: skeletal size (torso+thigh+shin+upper arm), auto-normalised per step by ctx.normalize_scale; QC (c) <= 4%

1.xray_window: local: both shoulder girdles, upper arms, upper rib cage

2.xray_window: local: near shoulder girdle + upper arm

steps.legacy_note: Day 1-5 (published) used 1 bone-wrong / 2 muscle-wrong / 3 bone-right / 4 muscle-right; look code maps every step through ctx.legacy(role)

xray.method: native per-pixel 3D shading: glass cavity 28+135*bone_sharp^1.15, luminous bone ramp tint->hot core, 0.48 window darkening

quality.qc_role: final check only; the look is correct by construction
quality.stray_lines: no stray/unanchored overlay lines: every fg component attached to mannequin/equipment (QC q); static bench layer excludes moving pixels (motion map) and median ghosts

ui.title: back-wall Kaushan title; where the mannequin or equipment overlaps it the title stays VISIBLE see-through at overlap_alpha.title (Day 4 rule, never fully hidden)
ui.preview: 4-slot top preview: frosted glass on the wall; over mannequin/equipment unfrosted (3D stays sharp) and visible at overlap_alpha.preview; equipment keeps (1-alpha) of its pixels = never cut/hidden/distorted
ui.callouts: never overlap equipment; per-step override allowed

overlap_alpha.day4_measured: title over body median 0.30 (p25 0.16 / p75 0.47, soft colour mask), preview >=0.35 (touch_p 0.65); locked to a constant 0.40 so it is identical over body and equipment

ui.callout_style_note: t547u: Day 4 callout look (one straight joint axis + cross ticks + vertex ring, horizontal leader, 86 px number at x=86 level with the target). 'day4_refined' = same with Day 5 crisp laser + 84 px number (side-by-side on the Day 6 sample sheet; owner picks).

6.why: incline DB press: elbow flare = torso vs upper arm

equipment.rule: never cut, clipped, holed, ghosted or distorted; inside frame; solid on every frame
equipment.detector: temporal backdrop plate + darker/neutral-chroma/texture differences + plate-disc completion

tempo_s.source: Day 4 master + build_day4_rdl_master.py (t544u): wave = 0.5-0.5*cos(2*pi*1.5*u) per 5 s step; measured reversals at 1.67 s / 3.33 s of every step

pipeline.commit: scripts/config/spec/plates only; never mp4, wav, tmp, caches or secrets
pipeline.cache: _cache_gymform/ keyed on sha1(day-config subset, spec, module sources)

structure: EXACTLY 3 lines separated by blank lines (from Day 6)
line 1: short one-line title statement (no question)
line 2: ONE personal-experience question ending with ?
line 3: save line (Save this for your next ... day.)
NO coaching body (video already explains it)
question_examples: What weight do you use for lateral raises?
Where do you feel your pulldowns most right now?
caption_rules.config_format: configs/dayNN.json caption = {title, question, save} (body forbidden); built + linted by gymform/caption.py

spoken_question.rule: final TTS line = short spoken version of the caption's experience question, appended right after the Step 4 line (inside the top hold / lower / 0.4s bottom), steps 1-3 lines and their breathing gaps unchanged
spoken_question.config_field: question_spoken (optional; default = shortest '?' clause of caption.question, pronouns -> 'it', else default)
spoken_question.default: Where do you feel it most?
spoken_question.step4_line_budget: Step 4 line (start 15.2s) + 0.25s gap + question must end <= 19.85s -> keep the Step 4 line <= ~11 words
spoken_question.checks: run_day.py --check lint (estimate) + tts assert (real durations) + QC (l) from tts timing sidecar

equipment_rules.static: static equipment (bench/machine) kept as native source pixels, opaque (equipment.static_equipment); QC (m)

source_rule: native 3D only (config.source.type native_3d_clip|native_3d_blender, mannequin/shorts/equipment native), 0% 2D overpaint; run_day guard + QC (o). See RULES.md

order.1: WRONG form, FRONT camera (bone X-Ray on joint days, muscle on muscle days)

pairs.rule: t521u: pair steps = SAME motion/angle from one clip; only the native rendering (bone X-Ray vs muscle fibre) differs. Config defines motions.wrong/right; steps derived (ctx.expand_motions); guard ctx.pair_lint; QC (s) keypoints + silhouette.

pair_tolerance.note: t541u: pair = same motion and angle within joint tolerance; DTW-aligned mean joint distance in % of skeletal size (noise floor 1.5-2.8%)

camera_plan.note: t556u: 2 motions (wrong, right) x 2 fixed native cameras (front, side); pairs 1/3 and 2/4 share one motion automatically. t554u: kinds by mistake_type. Length stays 4 x 5 s = 20 s on both day types.

fields.zoom: x the auto-normalised size (same scale all steps)
fields.focus_x/focus_y: canvas point for the median shoulder midpoint
fields.equipment_margin: x skeletal size kept around wrists/dumbbells

rules: mannequin scale identical across steps (QC c)
dumbbells never cut; bench may be partial (QC d/m)
single Lanczos resample from 720p + light unsharp, no blur; keep zoom moderate (upscale vs 720p reported in _normalized)
